Data structure for updating an existing authenticated user account.

All fields are optional to allow partial updates without overwriting unchanged data.

Includes mutable fields such as display_name, username, role, and is_active status.

This DTO excludes immutable fields like id, joined_at, and last_login_at.

email.description: Email address used for user login and communication

password_hash.description: Hashed password, supplied only when updating the user's credential

oneOf.description: User role for system permissions
User role for system permissions

ITodoListUserSession.IRequest.description: Request DTO for searching and retrieving todo list user sessions with filtering and pagination. Supports various search fields, pagination, and sorting.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting at 1.

limit.description: Number of results per page. Must be a positive integer.

oneOf.description: Field to sort the results by.
Field to sort the results by.

oneOf.description: Order of sorting: ascending or descending.
Order of sorting: ascending or descending.

order.description: Order of sorting: ascending or descending.

user_id.description: Filter sessions by specific user ID. Can be null to ignore this filter.

status.description: Filter sessions by their status. Can be null to include all statuses.

created_at_start.description: Filter sessions created from this date and time onwards.

created_at_end.description: Filter sessions created up to this date and time.

expires_at_end.description: Filter sessions with expiry dates up to this date and time.

ITodoListUserSession.description:
Detailed information about a user session within the Todo List application.

This entity captures the session details such as the owning user, IP address, accessed URL (href), referrer, and timestamps for creation and expiration. It is used to track active and historical user sessions for security auditing and session management.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user session

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the session was created

expired_at.description: Timestamp when the session expires; null for sessions without expiration

ip.description: IP address of the client initiating the session

referrer.description: Referrer URL from which the session originated

todo_list_user_id.description: UUID of the user owning this session, automatically set from JWT context; clients do not provide this field

ITodoListUserSession.ICreate.description:
Payload required for creating a new user session within the Todo List application.

Includes client connection metadata such as IP address, session URLs, expiration time, and user ownership. The owning user's id is obtained from the authenticated JWT and must NOT be included by the client.

href.description: URL the client is accessing in this session

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking; optional as server can infer it

referrer.description: Referrer URL for the session; the URL from which the client originated

expired_at.description: Timestamp when this session expires; can be null for sessions without expiration

ITodoListUserSession.IUpdate.description: Update fields for an existing user session in the Todo List system. This includes properties such as IP address, accessed URL, referrer URL, and expiration timestamp. The session to update is identified by its unique ID in the path parameter.

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking; optional as server infers it

href.description: URL the client is accessing in this session; nullable if not recorded

referrer.description: Referrer URL for the session; nullable if not recorded

expired_at.description: Timestamp when this session expires; can be null if session never expires

ITodoListTodo.IRequest.description: Parameters to filter and paginate the list of todo items for authenticated users in the Todo List service. Supports search queries, status filtering, priority filtering, date ranges, and pagination settings.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting at 1.

limit.description: Number of items to return per page, maximum 100.

search.description: Search string to filter todo items by keywords in title or description.

status.description: Filter todo items by status, e.g. pending, completed.

priority.description: Filter todo items by priority level.

created_from.description: Start date-time filter for the todo items creation date.

created_to.description: End date-time filter for the todo items creation date.

due_from.description: Start date-time filter for the due date of todo items.

due_to.description: End date-time filter for the due date of todo items.

ITodoListTodo.description: Represents an individual user's personal todo item with all its properties, including title, description, status, and due date. This is the full entity schema mapping to the todo_list_todos Prisma table.

id.description: Unique identifier of the todo item.

title.description: The title of the todo item, summarizing the task to be done.

description.description: Optional detailed description providing more context about the todo item. Can be null if not specified.

oneOf.description: Current status of the todo item. Must be one of: 'pending', 'completed', or 'deleted'.

status.description: Current status of the todo item. Must be one of: 'pending', 'completed', or 'deleted'.

due_date.description: Optional due date and time for the todo item in ISO 8601 format. Can be null if not specified.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the todo item was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the todo item was last updated.

ITodoListTodo.ICreate.description:
Schema for creating a new todo item in the todo_list_todos table.

This schema accurately models the user input needed for creating a todo item, excluding system generated fields.

The 'status' field indicates the todo item state and accepts values: 'pending', 'completed', or 'deleted'.

Optional fields like 'description' and 'due_date' offer additional detail.

title.description: Short text title summarizing the todo item task.

description.description: Optional detailed text description of the todo item. Null if not specified.

status.description:
Current todo item status indicating its completion state.

Must be one of 'pending', 'completed', or 'deleted'.

due_date.description: Optional due date and time for the todo item, ISO 8601 format. Must be future datetime if provided.

ITodoListTodoListGuest.ISummary.description:
Summary information of a guest todo list item for list and reference views.

Includes essential identifying and descriptive fields needed in summaries, defaulting to exclude verbose or sensitive data.

id.description: Unique identifier of the guest todo item

content.description: Brief content of the todo item

is_completed.description: Flag indicating whether the item is completed

created_at.description: Creation timestamp of the guest todo item

ITodoListTodoListUser.ISummary.description:
Summary information of an authenticated todo list user.

Contains key publicly visible user details used in lists, references, and minimal profile displays.

Excludes sensitive information like passwords, tokens, or personal contact details.

Used for efficient data transfer and display optimizations in user-related APIs.

id.description: Unique identifier of the authenticated user.

joined_at.description: Date and time when the user joined the service.

ITodoListUserSession.ISummary.description:
Summary information of a user's session in the Todo List application.

Provides overview details about a session including identifiers, timestamps and status, enabling efficient listing and reference without exposing full session details.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user session.

last_active_at.description: Timestamp of the last activity within the session.

is_active.description: Flag indicating if the session is currently active.

ITodoListTodo.ISummary.description:
Summary schema of a todo item including key fields to display in listings.

Excludes verbose details for efficiency.

Includes id, title, status, and due date.

id.description: Unique identifier of the todo item.

title.description: Short text title summarizing the todo task.

status.description:
Current todo item status as enum.

Values: 'pending', 'completed', 'deleted'.

due_date.description: Optional due date timestamp in ISO 8601 format; null if none specified.

ITodoListTodoListGuest.ICreate.description: Request payload for creating a new guest user account in the todo_list_guests table. Contains necessary information for guest registration and initial authorization.

nickname.description: Guest user's nickname, displayed in application for identification.

client_version.description: Version of the client application used by the guest, useful for compatibility checks and analytics.

ip.description: IP address of the guest client. Optional and recorded for auditing purposes.

href.description: The URL from which the guest initiated the registration, used for session tracking and referrer analytics.

referrer.description: Referrer URL, indicating the previous page leading to registration, used for session analytics.

ITodoListTodoListUser.ICreate.description: The user registration request payload for creating a new user account. Contains required registration details such as email, password, and optional profile details. Password field is plaintext and will be hashed by the backend during user creation.

email.description: The user's email address used for login and communications. Must be unique in the system.

password.description: The user's password in plaintext. Password is hashed by the backend prior to storage.

name.description: The user's full name for identification and display purposes.

ITodoListTodoListGuest.IAuthorized.description: Authorization response for a guest user after successful login or token refresh. Provides JWT tokens for continued access and unique guest identification.

id.description: Unique identifier of the guest user.

ITodoListTodoListGuest.IRefresh.description: Payload containing the refresh token used by a guest user to request new access tokens. The refresh token must be valid, non-expired, and correspond to the guest session to allow continuation of the guest access.

refresh_token.description: The JWT refresh token issued to the guest user needed for obtaining new access tokens.

ITodoListTodoListUser.IAuthorized.description:
Authorization response returned after successful user login or registration.
Includes user ID and an authorization token for authenticated sessions.

id.description: Unique identifier of the authorized user.

ITodoListTodoListUser.ILogin.description:
User login request payload containing credentials and session context fields.
Session context fields enable tracking of login origin and are mandatory for security auditing.

email.description: User's email address used for login and authentication.

password.description: User's password in plain text for verification purposes.

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking (optional, server can extract if not provided).

href.description: URL of the page initiating the login request (mandatory for session audit).

referrer.description: Referrer URL from which the login request originated (mandatory for session audit).

ITodoListTodoListUser.IRefresh.description: Request payload for refreshing JWT access and refresh tokens for an authenticated user. Contains the existing valid refresh token used to obtain new tokens, ensuring continuous authenticated sessions.

refresh_token.description: Valid refresh token string previously issued to the user for session continuation.

ITodoListTodo.IUpdate.description:
Update DTO for a user's personal todo item.

Includes all mutable fields and allows partial updates for each.

Fields like 'status' follow the enum with allowed values.

All fields optional in update variant.

title.description: Short text title summarizing the todo task.

description.description: Optional detailed text description of the todo task. Null if unspecified.

status.description:
Indicates current status of the todo item.

Allowed values: 'pending', 'completed', 'deleted'.

due_date.description: Optional due date timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Validators enforce future dates.
